Q-7281: How many days from 2023-11-24 to 2024-05-31 (count end, not start)?

Answer: 189

Calculation:
- Nov 2023: 6 days (Nov 25-30)
- Dec 2023: 31 days
- Jan 2024: 31 days
- Feb 2024: 29 days (leap year)
- Mar 2024: 31 days
- Apr 2024: 30 days
- May 2024: 31 days
Total: 6+31+31+29+31+30+31 = 189
